title: 1999 HMMT February Geometry Problem 1
statement:
Two \(10 \times 24\) rectangles are inscribed in a circle as shown. Find the shaded area.

[Diagram omitted from this imported transcription; consult the HMMT archive while reviewing the problem.]

solutions.text: The rectangles are \(10 \times 24\), so their diagonals, which are diameters of the circle, have length 26. Therefore the area of the circle is \(\pi 13^{2}\), and the overlap is a \(10 \times 10\) square, so the shaded area is \(\pi 13^{2}-2 \cdot 10 \cdot 24+10^{2}=\mathbf{1 6 9} \pi-\mathbf{3 8 0}\).
